page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at the top; a copper-engraved oval portrait with inscriptions in the middle; a four-line Latin verse below the portrait. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Quicunque sævas sensit Eumenidum faces Ardere fibris, hostis humani Nero, Phalarisque generis, vincitur sævitia. Testare Belga, quem furor tulit mens.

page.notes: The engraved oval portrait is not transcribed as running text. Its inscription reads "FERDINANDUS A. TOLEDO, DUX ALVÆ, etc. GUBERN. GENERAL. BELG. A. 1568", and the outer ring, only partly legible, reads "DUX ALVÆ ... OBSID ... HAR[?]". The verse lines are set in a larger, slightly irregular type; the transcription follows the printed line breaks. The running head has been normalised to u/v usage.
